caption: A train crosses a metal bridge, and the water in a puddle on the road below shows shivering rings.

sa.check: A train crosses a metal bridge.
A puddle lies on the road below the bridge.
The puddle's surface shows shivering rings.
The rings are fine shivers, not splashes.
The rings appear while the train is on the bridge.

pc.expect: Rings cover the puddle while the train is on the bridge; the puddle is still before and settles after.
pc.fail: The train crosses and the puddle stays glassy; or the puddle shivers hardest with the bridge empty and calms as the train crosses; or the puddle keeps shivering unchanged long after the train has gone from view.

pc.expect: The water stays in the puddle at its level; the shiver is in place.
pc.fail: The puddle's water slides across the road; or one ring spreads from a point as from a dropped stone with nothing falling; or the water rises into a bulge; or the puddle's outline moves along the road.

pc.expect: The train runs along the bridge in one direction without a break.
pc.fail: The train jumps forward between frames; or its carriages separate and rejoin; or it moves sideways off the rails without falling.

pc.expect: Water stays in the puddle and any drips from the bridge fall downward.
pc.fail: Water lifts out of the puddle; or drips from the bridge fall upward; or the puddle climbs the kerb.

pc.expect: One train on one bridge, one puddle; the train passes through no girder.
pc.fail: The train passes through the bridge girders; or carriages appear or vanish mid-train; or the puddle vanishes in one frame; or the bridge changes shape.

pc.expect: The train's livery, the road markings and the puddle's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The train's livery changes; or the road markings shift; or the puddle changes colour.
